references.text: Isaiah speaks of God's word going out and not returning empty, which reflects the idea of the power and effect of the word, similar to the parallel in Matthew about the seed that is sown.
The book of Psalms speaks of hiding God's word in one's heart so as not to sin against him, reflecting the importance of understanding and keeping the word in the heart.
Luke gives a parallel explanation of the parable of the sower, emphasizing the importance of hearing and understanding God's word.
Mark also gives an explanation of the parable of the sower, similar to the explanation in Matthew, highlighting the importance of how one receives God's word.
